verdict.rationale: Letta's memory model lets you pass arbitrary starting memory that becomes Markdown files in a git-backed 'memory repository' (letta-docs-11), and MemFS supports keyword/semantic search over that repository (letta-docs-28/41), suggesting some capacity to load non-chat content into memory. However there is no explicit documentation of ingesting structured business data (JSON, databases) or document formats (PDF, docs) with parsing/chunking pipelines — memory is framed mainly around markdown notes and conversation-derived facts (dreaming/consolidation from conversations, letta-docs-27). Missing for 10: explicit document/JSON ingestion tooling or connectors, evidence of structured-data import, and independent/hands-on confirmation that arbitrary business data (not just markdown) can be loaded into memory.
